description:
Hwitae was the kid who used to live next door. Now, he’s an Olympic champion with the whole world watching and he’s sleeping in Woohee’s bed.
Desperate to mend her broken heart after a disastrous getaway, Woohee offers Hwitae a temporary place to stay. But boundaries blur when a night of heavy drinking wipes her memory clean, leaving her with a naked gold medalist and a life altering confession that she was the one who begged him to stay.
He’s never wanted anyone else, and he’s not letting her go. On this intricately spun web, every move she makes only pulls her deeper.

**※ Content Warning: This work includes sensitive and potentially disturbing themes, including coercive relationships and gaslighting. Reader discretion is advised.**
